title: Fixing a coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction on $n$ coordinates, let $i$ be one of those coordinates, and let $s\in\{\pm1\}$. The restriction obtained by fixing coordinate $i$ according to $s$ agrees with $\rho$ at every other coordinate, and fixes coordinate $i$ to $+1$ if $s=+1$ and to $-1$ otherwise.
